target.title: fix(anthropic): don't crash models list when a configured Sonnet 5 model has no cost
target.body:
## Problem

`openclaw models list` aborts with:

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'input')
    at applyAnthropicSonnet5Cost (register.runtime)
```

whenever the user config supplies an Anthropic Sonnet 5 model row without `cost` metadata — e.g. a bare `agents.defaults.models["anthropic/claude-sonnet-5"]` runtime binding. `applyAnthropicSonnet5Cost` compares `params.model.cost.input` unconditionally.

## Fix

Optional chaining on the cost comparison. A costless model falls through the equality check and gets the canonical Sonnet 5 cost applied, which is the intended normalization.

## Test

Added a regression test: normalizing a Sonnet 5 model with `cost: undefined` no longer throws and returns the canonical cost. Verified it fails on main and passes with the fix.
